summary: ANDVARI CAPITAL III AS (org. no. 891 516 452) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-07-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 64.312 (Alternative investeringsfond (aif) som ikke er verdipapirfond); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.6 m and net income was -NOK 580 507. Board chair: Lars Aasland Grotmol; auditor: BDO AS.
